title: Exact minimum-cover membership and joint analysis for the 29-row runner-up target 00000000000000003800000009000000 via shared-memo anchored lazy matching DP
method: Published even/odd-r cover framework, with pm values supplied by a shared-memo anchored lazy matching DP (state cap 12M, wall budget 1500s). The anchored-reachable state space of this parent is only ~514k states per 28-row root, so all formulas run exactly where an all-mask 2^29 table would not fit. The lazy pm and the framework are validated against the published cost-12 output (all 1,151 singleton memberships reproduced exactly).
interpretation_guard: Cover-plan combinatorics only. Membership counts alternative minimum cover plans containing a root; it is not a search cost and implies nothing about WIN/REFUTED outcomes. REFUTED-D10 and STERILE are not LOSS proofs.
unknown_status: Standard 11x11 empty board, two-stone roots {49,60}/{59,60}, S2 {59,60}, and classes 1/2/4 remain UNKNOWN.
